steps.en: Set up the app and agent, then enter OpenAI and Jev keys
steps.zh: 启动网页与 agent，再填写 OpenAI 和 Jev 密钥

steps.en: Ask for an explanation, comparison or working calculator
steps.zh: 请求解释、对比或可操作的计算器

steps.en: Routes the answer to text, table or generated interactive UI
steps.zh: 选择文字、表格或生成式交互界面

steps.en: Streams the answer into the conversation with local controls
steps.zh: 将带本地控件的回答流入对话

value.en: Users can manipulate an answer rather than only read it
value.zh: 用户可以操作答案，不只是阅读
